title: feat(ui): retire the grid's staged edit model with its host interface
body:
Fixes #35827

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` never taught the grid's host props (`cellSelection`, `onBatchSave`, `singleClickEdit`, "Save All" have zero hits there); none of them is authorable metadata.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：所有可编辑表格只剩一种编辑方式，单击选中单元格、双击或回车进入编辑、提交即保存；“全部保存”栏和行内保存按钮全部消失。
- 为什么做：两套编辑模式并存，旧的暂存模式只剩一个宿主属性在用，按你的裁决让旧模式和它的接口一起退役。
- 出错会怎样：自己画表格的 React 宿主若还写着旧属性，升级后类型检查直接报错；没有保存通道的裸表格只读显示并在控制台警告一次，可整版回退。
- 要你做什么：本 PR 约 4000 行改动，超过三千行，需要你本人落地。

## What changes

Ruling A on the card ("the old mode and its interface retire together"):

- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`**: the `cellSelection={false}` arm of `ObjectGrid`, `onBatchSave` and the default batch save are removed. `cellSelection` accepts only `true` (ask for select-first on a read-only grid). The default cell save (`defaultRowSave`) keeps only the select-first path: rule check, claim-answer warnings, `If-Match` write, conflict dialog, Undo toast. The record verdicts are now asked on first cell selection only (the mount-time ask served the staged arm).
- **`@object-ui/components`**: `data-table` loses the staged arm (pending-changes bar, Save All / Cancel All, the row save/cancel column, click-to-edit, the amber tints) and its fallback copy rows. Ruling term (2), bare-primitive arm: **loud refusal**. An editable `data-table` edits only inside a `GridCellSelection` host that also passes `onRowSave`; otherwise it renders read-only and logs one `[ObjectUI] DataTable editable:` console warning naming what is missing. Writing through a data source the table does not own was rejected because the primitive has no `objectName` or record identity of its own.
- **`@object-ui/types`**: `DataTableSchema.onBatchSave` is `?: never` on the TS face and a `retired` handler-key refusal on the zod mirror; `DataTableSchema.singleClickEdit` is removed (it only chose how the staged editor opened). Parity ledgers updated (KnownDrift 92 to 91, RuntimeOnlyDeclared 31 to 30). The `keyboardNavigation` describe drops its staged sentence.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**: `ResourceListPage` stops passing `cellSelection={false}`. It is read-only, so it keeps click-to-open (assumption A1, measured: its 14 test files pass, and a read-only grid never mounts the select-first provider).
- Docs: `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` and the plugin-grid README describe the one editing model and the `onRowSave` hand-off.
- Changeset `.changeset/35827-data-table-staged-edit-retired.md` with both declaration lines, the BREAKING banner and the FROM/TO table.
- **`@objectstack/spec`**: the ADR-0087 D3 entry `data-table-staged-edit-retired` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.data-table-staged-edit-retired.ts`). Protocol 19 opened on main while this was in flight, so the entry is a step-19 file; step 19's rationale is one hand-written string, so `registry.ts.template` is untouched. No conversion: nothing it retires is authorable metadata.

Outside-host census (ruling premise clause): public clones of `hotcrm` and `gallery` at their default-branch heads have zero hits for `cellSelection={false}` and `onBatchSave`. No named outside host, no fork.

## Tests

Staged-path pins either migrated to the select-first gestures (click, then double-click, Enter, F2 or typing; reading the per-cell save) or were deleted together with the behaviour they pinned, each deletion leaving a comment that names the pin covering the same ground. Deleted files: `data-table-batch-per-row-12292`, `data-table-refusal-cells-27520`, `ObjectGrid.inlineEditPendingKeyedByRecord-12310`. New helpers in `components/src/__tests__/test-utils.tsx`: `renderSelectFirstTable` and `openCellEditor`.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- `@object-ui/components`: 4958 passed
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid`: 2774 passed
- `@object-ui/types`: 10512 passed
- plugin-list, plugin-view, i18n, plugin-form, data-objectstack onMutation: 7654 passed, 0 failed
- app-shell `ResourceListPage*`: 14 files, 105 passed
- type-check: types, components, plugin-grid, plugin-list, app-shell clean
- eslint on the touched files: no errors
- dispatch gates, first round: 70 of 73 green; `check-adr-0087-registration` was red until the entry landed and is green now; `@objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` refused (exit 3) because `@objectstack/client-react` was not built in this container, and nothing under `skills/**` or that package is touched
- the 41 gates the spec file adds: 39 green; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` refused for a shallow clone and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` for an unbuilt `knowledge-turso`, both outside this change
- spec migration tests (`src/migrations`) green
- dogfood battery on `deefadb3`: 487 files, 4129 passed, 68 skipped, 0 failed
- CI Test Core 5/10 on `deefadb3`: one CLI integration file timed out in its 480 s setup hook; the same file passes locally on the same head (54 of 54), so its failed job was re-run once

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **`packages/spec` fence.** The claim's Amendment 1 admits the one semantic entry file, and the maintainer approved it by name; it is the only `packages/spec` path this diff touches. `'@objectstack/spec': minor` is in the changeset with it.
- **Size.** About 4000 changed lines (1216 added, 2787 removed), above the 3000-line line, so this lands by the maintainer.
- **Dead locale keys.** The locale packs still carry `table.saveAll`, `table.cancelAll`, `table.modified`, `table.saveRow`, `table.cancelChanges`; nothing reads them now. Left for a follow-up so this diff stays off the locale files.
- **Fenced, now stale.** `ui/packages/fields/README.md` (around lines 145 to 147) and `FieldEditWidget.tsx` (around lines 216 to 217) still describe a grid without `cellSelection`. `ui/packages/fields/**` is outside this claim.
- **Unused option.** `useRecordCrudVerdicts`' `updateOnMount` option has no caller left; removing it is a small follow-up.

## Verification

Files to read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: `defaultRowSave` (the only save path now) and the `hostCellSelection` derivation.
2. `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`: the `selectFirst && onRowSave` edit gate and the read-only fallback.
3. `ui/packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts`: the `onBatchSave` retired refusal.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-autosave-35685.test.tsx` passes, and its "no staged fallback" describe shows an editable table with no host rendering read-only with exactly one warning line.
